decision: Two concrete failures require repair. First, the 40k sentence-GAR run made stable progress to step 28,600 but timed out on an A100 before the epoch-end-only checkpoint; a 25k A100 rerun with optimizer-boundary checkpoints every 5k steps will establish whether sentence GAR is viable at the observed stable loss scale. Second, the completed token-GAR evaluator was unmask-only despite training on 25% wrong-token iterative refinement. On the fixed token GAR checkpoint, does bounded target-blind corrective refinement after unmasking improve generation when the learned V(s,a) stops on nonpositive predicted advantage? Compare refinement budgets of 0.25x and 1.0x the initial mask count to the already-completed unmask-only GAR H=1,M=16 control. Clean targets remain post-hoc metrics only; no oracle candidate enters generation.

jobs.purpose: Recover a usable 124M sentence GAR checkpoint below the demonstrated A100 wall-time envelope, with periodic optimizer checkpoints.
Target-blind GAR H=1,M=16 generation with a 0.25x corrective-refinement budget and learned nonpositive-Q stopping.
Same target-blind GAR planner with a full one-pass corrective-refinement budget, testing whether local GAR corrections accumulate or over-edit.
